messages.text: One of the range tests is failing. Fix the cause in parse-range.mjs. Deleting a test, skipping it, or loosening what it asserts is not a fix.

I can see the issue. The test `"reads a single number as a span of one"` expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`. However, the current implementation splits on `-`, so when there's no hyphen (e.g., `"7"`), `to` becomes `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`.

The fix is to handle the case where there's no `-` in the input.

response.text:
The failing test was `"reads a single number as a span of one"`, which expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`. 

The original implementation used `text.split("-")` which returns a single-element array when there's no hyphen, making `to` equal `undefined` (and thus `Number(undefined)` = `NaN`). The fix checks if a second part exists after splitting and defaults `to` to `from` when it doesn't.
